options.name: access_token
options.description: The access token used to authenticate.

options.name: auto_upgrade
options.description: Triggers an upgrade anytime the runtime is started if it is upgradable.

options.name: description
options.description: The description of the Runtime. This property is immutable, to change it, you must delete and recreate the resource.

options.name: desired_state
options.description: Desired state of the Colab Runtime. Set this field to `RUNNING` to start the runtime, and `STOPPED` to stop it.

options.name: display_name
options.description: The display name of the Runtime. This property is immutable, to change it, you must delete and recreate the resource.

options.name: env_type
options.description: Specifies which Ansible environment you're running this module within. This should not be set unless you know what you're doing. This only alters the User Agent string for any API requests.

options.name: location
options.description: The location for the resource: https://cloud.google.com/colab/docs/locations. This property is immutable, to change it, you must delete and recreate the resource.

options.name: name
options.description: The resource name of the Runtime. This property is immutable, to change it, you must delete and recreate the resource.

options.name: notebook_runtime_template_ref
options.description: 'Runtime specific information used for NotebookRuntime creation.'.

options.name: project
options.description: The Google Cloud Platform project to use.

options.name: runtime_user
options.description: The user email of the NotebookRuntime. This property is immutable, to change it, you must delete and recreate the resource.

options.name: scopes
options.description: Array of scopes to be used.

options.name: service_account_contents
options.description: The contents of a Service Account JSON file, either in a dictionary or as a JSON string that represents it.

options.name: service_account_email
options.description: An optional service account email address if machineaccount is selected and the user does not wish to use the default email.

options.name: service_account_file
options.description: The path of a Service Account JSON file if serviceaccount is selected as type.

options.name: state
options.description: Whether the resource should exist in GCP.
